scoring_justification: Slope of log‑log power spectrum recomputed from CSV output; compared to expected ranges derived from the paper’s reported spectral shape (1/f vs white noise). No self‑reported metric is trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected slope ranges for Xe and Ar atoms
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures: Fig.1 shows 1/f spectrum (slope ~ –1); Fig.4 shows flat spectrum for Ar (slope ~ 0).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper’s qualitative description; ranges are wide enough to accommodate honest replication variability.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from the paper’s own reported spectral shapes, not arbitrary.

outputs.description: Averaged power spectrum of individual Xe atom potential-energy fluctuations in the pure Xe55 cluster at T~69.6 K. Contains frequency (positive, increasing) and corresponding power.
Power spectrum of the Ar impurity atom's potential-energy fluctuations in the ArXe54 cluster at T=68 K.
Averaged power spectrum of Xe atom potential-energy fluctuations in the ArXe54 cluster at T=68 K.

output_contract.notes: Only the power spectra are scored; radial distributions and multi-Gaussian fits are not required. The submitted CSV files must contain two columns (frequency and power) and allow the checker to perform a log-log linear fit to extract the spectral slope. No header is required but it is recommended for clarity.
